remarks: So much to like about this 1 Bedrm 1 Bath apartment in a Secure entry Building, with In Unit Washer and Dryer and a designated Garage Parking Spot. The Windemere Building is within easy walking distance to Downtown Stamford, the Mall, Restaurants, UCONN Stamford Branch and the Train. This unit has a feeling of spaciousness with an Open Concept Design- blending the kitchen, dining and living room together. The Kitchen is well appointed with Granite Counters, Stainless Steel Appliances, washer and dryer, counter seating and an unusually large storage space. Kitchen opens to a generously sized Living Room with wood floors and space for dining or a desk. The exterior wall of windows adds lots of light into the space and the hallway design separates the Living Room from the Bedroom, making the unit feel much bigger. The spacious Bedroom has two good sized Closets and Wood Flooring. The Bathroom features a tub/shower combination, tile flooring and a linen closet. This unit comes with a garage parking spot if needed - great for the winter and no worries about finding parking. Other amenities include a newly renovated Fitness Center for residents, and outdoor space featuring tables, chairs and Barbecue Grills for gathering with friends. Available Furnished or Unfurnished. Good credit and references required.
